name: Hyoung-Kee Choi
biography: Prof. Hyoung-Kee Choi received his Ph.D. in electrical and computer engineering from Georgia Institute of Technology in 2001. He is a professor at Sungkyunkwan University, South Korea. He joined Lancope in 2001 until his leave in 2004, where he guided and contributed to research in Internet security. His research interests span network security and vulnerability assessment.
